svg.aria-label: HPX-DIAG-018 — Workspace and buffer state machines
svg.desc: Which session/unlock states permit editing and which acknowledgement states remain uncertain? Scope: Local unless explicitly F / G. No inferred mechanism; F nodes are future contracts, G nodes are gated code.
